title: periandra coccinea
intro: Periandra coccinea, commonly known as the Red Cow's Tongue or Red Bristle, is a plant species in the family Sapindaceae native to tropical regions of Central and South America. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce the risk of chronic diseases. The therapeutic actions of Periandra coccinea include its analgesic and antipyretic effects, making it useful in the treatment of fever and pain. The bioactive constituents of Periandra coccinea include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
